title: The longest train – level 1
paragraphs: South Africa tests a very long train. The train is 7.6 kilometres long. It has 696 empty wagons. It goes 860 kilometres from the ocean to a mine. Electric and diesel engines help move the big train across the country.
The company says that this is now the longest train in the whole world. It is longer than a famous train in Australia from many years ago. That train is 7.2 kilometres long.
People believe that this big test is a great step for their country’s trains and business. It will help move heavy things across long distances much faster and better in the future.

words.d: one of many parts of a train which carries things or materials
a deep hole in the earth from which workers get minerals, stones, or other materials
